title: The Victorian Heritage Register: places registered under the Heritage Act, with the dates of their registration and its last amendment
provider: Heritage Council of Victoria, the Victorian Heritage Database API v1 (https://api.heritagecouncil.vic.gov.au/v1), listed on DataVic by the Department of Transport and Planning
credit: Victorian Heritage Database: Heritage Council of Victoria, CC BY 4.0
licence: CC BY 4.0 (DataVic's record of the API, victorian-heritage-database-api, licence cc-by; checked 2026-11-04)
citation: Heritage Council of Victoria, Victorian Heritage Database API v1, https://api.heritagecouncil.vic.gov.au/ ; https://discover.data.vic.gov.au/dataset/victorian-heritage-database-api
format: HAL JSON. places.json: the search of places on the Victorian Heritage Register (heritage authority 1086) in a box (geo = lat1,lon1,lat2,lon2), one page of up to 1,000 (page_count, total_items; _embedded.places[] with id, name, latlon "lat,lon", vhr_number, location, heritage_authority_id, url, and a summary). The search gives no dates: each place's record, /v1/places/{id}, holds registered_on and registration_last_amended_on (texts such as "October 9, 1974"), status, vhr_number, latitude, longitude, addresses, heritage_act_categories, construction years, and descriptions, architects and images, which the product does not keep. fetch.py fetches the search; its follow rules cannot reach a list nested under _embedded, so the records are fetched by data/products/city_events.py from the ids of places.json, into places/<id>.json beside it, with their own provenance (places/retrieval.json), and only those not yet held.
coverage: Victoria; the profile takes the Hoddle Grid's box, -37.8205 to -37.8075 S and 144.9535 to 144.9735 E (160 places on the register on 2026-11-04; about 5 MB with their records). Only the last amendment of a registration is given, not every amendment.
